legacy.frame_mapping: Target f030 EXR supplies colour, other frames validate visibility

parent_protocols.fit: Shared FP32 local_placement from 6cff9f9 using GT axial center depth for reference and target at GT hits. GT background excludes foreground from the fit.

metrics.color: Scene-linear RGB L1 and PSNR in [0,1]. Biased pixels have mean absolute RGB error > .03. Compare one placed parent per projected pixel, nearest pre-fit depth to peeled center. Depth match is within max(0.01 m, 0.5%).
metrics.depth: Post-affine, pre-footprint-order axial depth versus peeled center. All projected comparisons and depth-matched set reported.
metrics.noise: Local high-pass RMS on display luminance, flat pixels of the recoverable region. The parent maps have no contiguous 7×7 flat support.
metrics.sse: Exact integrated RGB SSE partitioned by any versus no hidden hit in the pixel across the 64 rays. The ray proxy compares each ray with the same integrated Cycles target because per-ray reference RGB is unavailable.
metrics.optical: Pooled RGB display PSNR, SSE / (3 * pixels).

finding.confirmed: The cache accepts a visible off-axis surface point, then obtains its colour from a whole input pixel, often mixed with foreground. The cached RGB is exactly reproducible. Recolouring depth-matched parents from the target peeled plate accounts for most of the negative effect in the four focus cases with unchanged placement and composition.
finding.remaining: Current plate removes all named foreground and gives one center hit. Other hidden surfaces and off-axis radiance are missing. A comparable complete oracle requires per-surface colour at target support, which the existing files cannot supply.
finding.disposition: Leave formal scores tagged pending. No production change or formal 87-case rerender. Stage 3b/3c actual Query has no direct dependency on the substitute.

known_reference_deltas: All eight f030 on/off pairs reproduced archived PSNR within 0.01 dB.
